title: 第12章 我不骗女人，只给她们选择-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    阳光穿透香格里拉总统套房的落地窗，在地毯上切出一道金色的光斑。

    林川睁开眼。

    没有逼仄的出租屋，没有早高峰的汽车鸣笛，只有中央空调极其轻微的运转声。

    他靠在床头，点了一根烟。

    来深圳的第一步已经踩稳了。

    钱在股市里滚着，公司注册、找房子也有林知秋去盯着。

    但出门总得有个代步工具。总不能天天让酒店的司机开着S600跟着，太扎眼，也不方便。

    得买辆车。

    林川吐出一口烟圈，脑子里浮现出一张明艳的脸。

    狐狸眼，红唇，还有那件紧绷的制服。

    他伸手从床头柜上拿过那张粉色的便签纸。

    上面是一串娟秀的电话号码。

    沈曼。

    林川可不信什么一生一世一双人。

    他拿起手机，按下那串号码。

    同一时间。

    深圳某航空公司协议酒店。

    沈曼正坐在梳妆台前，手里捏着一支口红，半天没拧开。

    今天是她休息的最后一天。

    前天下午下飞机开始，她的手机就一直放在手边。

    没响过。

    她看着镜子里的自己，自嘲地扯了扯嘴角。

    沈曼啊沈曼，你真以为自己长得漂亮，人家那种住两万一晚总统套房的人就会主动联系你？

    那种级别的男人，身边缺女人吗？

    她叹了口气，把口红扔进化妆包里，准备换衣服下楼随便吃点东西。

    嗡——嗡——

    桌上的手机突然震动起来。

    沈曼看了一眼屏幕。

    一个陌生的本地号码。

    她故意等了三秒，才滑开接听键。

    “喂？”声音控制得恰到好处，温柔，但不急切。

    “醒了？”

    电话那头，一个低沉干净的男声。

    带着点早晨刚醒的慵懒，还有一种极其自然的熟稔。

    就像他们不是只见过一面的陌生人，而是认识了很久。

    沈曼的手指攥紧了睡衣下摆。

    是他。那个在头等舱里只喝了一杯黑咖啡的男人。

    “林先生？”她试探着叫了一声。

    “叫林先生太老气了。”林川在那头笑了一声，“林川。”

    沈曼的耳根有些发热。

    这男人，跟在飞机上那种生人勿近的样子完全不一样。

    带着一种坏坏的侵略性，但拿捏得刚好，不让人觉得油腻。

    “林川……”沈曼在嘴里嚼了一下这两个字，“你找我？”

    “沈曼小姐，不是你留的纸条，说要请我吃饭吗？”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Sunlight penetrates through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Shangri-La Presidential Suite, cutting a golden spot on the carpet.

Lin Chuan opened his eyes.

There are no cramped rental houses, no car horns during the morning rush hour, only the slightest sound of the central air conditioner running.

He leaned against the bed and lit a cigarette.

The first step to coming to Shenzhen has been taken.

Money is rolling in the stock market, and Lin Zhiqiu is there to keep an eye on company registration and house hunting.

But you must have a means of transportation when going out.You can't let the hotel driver follow you around in an S600 every day. It's too eye-catching and inconvenient.

You have to buy a car.

Lin Chuan blew out a smoke ring and a bright face appeared in his mind.

Fox eyes, red lips, and that tight uniform.

He reached out and took the pink note from the bedside table.

“ Above is a string of Juanxiu’s phone numbers.

Shen Man.

Lin Chuan doesn’t believe in two people for the rest of their lives.

He picked up the phone and pressed the number.

At the same time.

A hotel contracted by an airline company in Shenzhen.

Shen Man was sitting in front of the dressing table, holding a lipstick in his hand and not opening it for a long time.

Today is her last day of rest.

Since getting off the plane the afternoon before yesterday, she has kept her mobile phone at hand.

It didn’t ring.

She looked at herself in the mirror and twitched her lips in self-deprecation.

Shen Man, Shen Man, do you really think that because you are beautiful, someone like you who lives in a presidential suite worth 20,000 yuan a night will contact you?

Does a man of that level lack women around him?

She sighed, threw her lipstick into her makeup bag, and prepared to change clothes and go downstairs to have something to eat.



The phone on the table suddenly vibrated.

Shen Man glanced at the screen.

An unfamiliar local number.

She deliberately waited for three seconds before sliding the answer button.

"Hello?" The voice was controlled just right, gentle but not urgent.

"Are you awake?"

There was a deep, clean male voice on the other end of the phone.

There is a bit of laziness like just waking up in the morning, and an extremely natural familiarity.

It’s like they are not strangers who have only met once, but have known each other for a long time.

Shen Man’s fingers clenched the hem of her pajamas.

It’s him.The man who only drank a cup of black coffee in first class.

"Mr. Lin?" She called tentatively.

"It's too old-fashioned to call you Mr. Lin." Lin Chuan laughed on the other end, "Lin Chuan."

Shen Man’s ears felt a little warm.

This man is completely different from the one on the plane who keeps away from strangers.

It has a bad aggressiveness, but it’s just right and doesn’t make people feel greasy.

"Linchuan..." Shen Man chewed these two words in his mouth, "Are you looking for me?"

"Miss Shen Man, didn't you leave a note saying you wanted to treat me to dinner?"
